title: Procurement Delegation and Competition Policy
content: Purchases below 5,000 USD may use an approved catalog or one documented quote. Purchases from 5,000 through 24,999 USD require at least two comparable written quotes unless a documented sole-source exception is approved by Procurement. Purchases of 25,000 USD or more require a competitive sourcing event and Procurement Director review. Purchase requests must not be split to avoid competition or approval thresholds. All requests require a business purpose, cost center, supplier identity, and accountable human approval before commitment.

title: Restricted Category and Security Review Standard
content: Software that processes confidential information requires Security review and a current data-processing assessment before purchase approval. A request in a restricted category cannot proceed to approval until required reviews are recorded. Missing evidence must be treated as an open exception, not as a positive finding. Supplier sanctions status must be clear and current.

title: Urgent Purchase Handling
content: Urgency does not waive policy, budget, security, sanctions, or approval controls. An urgent request may receive expedited routing only after all mandatory evidence has been collected. The requester must document the service impact and the reason standard lead time is not feasible.
